read_by.transcription: independent readers working only from gridded tiles of the committed drawing crops, without table data
read_by.verification: the curator overlaid every page with the reads, the controls and the table placements mapped through the page's control fit; kept the readers' jet-bumper, flipper-pivot and frame-corner controls after checking them on the overlays, dropped the lamp page's misread lower jet bumper and read the switch page's top-right frame corner on a widened crop; marked the cabinet reads 13, 18 and 88 as outside the playfield; measured the placements no table object supplies at the socket centres and leader ends checked on zoomed crops; and recorded as excluded checks the table placements whose callout a documented finding puts on another part

drawing_callout_check.rule: A placement is validated when its own callout on the factory location drawing (each callout paired with at most one placement of its label, nearest first) lands within 0.07 normalized of it under two least-squares fits of that page: one on independently read controls (jet-bumper caps and flipper pivots, or another crisp mechanism feature where balloons hide a pivot), and one, measured leave-one-out, on the page's other callout reads, from which any read beyond the limit is dropped. Placements without such a read keep their table status. Placements measured on a drawing are never checked against it.

projection_classes.gi: The table's G.I. light collections for strings 1, 2 and 4, as candidates only: the lights are invisible light-map sources, not modelled sockets, and no drawing or bulb count locates G.I. bulbs.
projection_classes.lamp: The Light each lamp's TimerInterval binds, observed and validated where the lamp drawing's callout agrees; 28, 37 and 44 place both bulbs. The sockets of the A-14305 and C-12709 boards (55-58, 63-68) and lamp 51, which the table models only as placeholders, are measured on the lamp drawing and stay observed; the Admit One lamp 18 on the back panel takes the drawing's x at the playfield's rear edge. The backbox letters 71-78 and the Start button lamp 88 are controlled not-applicable records.
projection_classes.solenoid: The script-driven flasher Light, the popper kicker, the slingshot wall or the jet bumper for each solenoid, observed and validated where the solenoid drawing's own symbol agrees. The trough and outhole coils project onto the ball seats they kick and stay observed with them, and the flipper windings project onto the flipper pivots, without a check; the hologram push motor and the lift ramp coils are measured on the drawing.
projection_classes.switch: The VPX collision object the retained script binds to each matrix switch (trigger, kicker, target, bumper or slingshot wall), observed and validated where the switch drawing's own callout agrees within the limit. Switches 16 and 17, whose callouts the drawing transposes, keep the table object without a check. The trough switches 55-58, which the drawing labels with pointerless balloons one ball position away, keep the table's ball seats without a check and stay observed. The ramp switches 18, 35, 36, 61, 62 and 64, whose table triggers sit 0.08 or more from the drawn switches or are swapped (62/64), and the lift ramp switch 38, which has no table object, are measured on the switch drawing and stay observed.

promotion_decision: partial: the factory drawings validate most table placements, but the chase-light strings and G.I. 0 and 3 cannot be placed until their wiring is settled, the G.I. strings are only candidates, and the trough and the drawing measurements stay observed.
unresolved_geometry: The 32 #86 chase bulbs on the swirl ramp's three boards and the bowl's board: which bulbs belong to which of the eight strings (lamps 91-98) and which ramp boards G.I. 0 and G.I. 3 power are unresolved (conflict.chase-light-board-group-assignment), so lamps 91-98 and G.I. 0 and 3 have no placement.
The general-illumination bulbs of strings 1, 2 and 4 rest on the retained table's light-map sources; no modelled socket, drawing or count locates them, so they are only candidates.
The trough switches 55-58 and the trough and outhole coils rest on the table's ball seats, which the switch drawing does not mark, so they stay observed.
Drawing measurements stay observed: no retained table object corroborates their positions.
